description: A fingerprint pasted with the trailing comma is rejected with a generic format message that does not name the comma, although the console sentence puts a comma right after the fingerprint.
expected: The CLI trims surrounding punctuation or says 'remove the trailing comma'.
actual: --fingerprint must look like "a1b2 c3d4 e5f6 7890", exactly as the console shows it.
suggested_fix: Strip leading/trailing non-hex punctuation before validating.

description: CLI messages and dialogs send the user to 'Settings' but the page is titled 'Activity & deletion' (sidebar link and header) and the passphrase card sits under the activity table.
expected: The page or sidebar link is called Settings, or the messages name the real page.
actual: Settings is not a visible label anywhere in the console.
suggested_fix: Rename the page or reword the CLI/dialog copy to 'Activity & deletion page'.

description: The fingerprint is small grey prose with no Copy button; on a phone it wraps mid-value.
expected: A monospaced fingerprint with a Copy button (as the passphrase and key already have).
actual: Selecting text is the only way; the sentence's comma gets selected.
suggested_fix: Show the fingerprint in its own mono block with Copy.

description: On the Activity table at 390px the WHEN and WHO header cells spill 20px and 12px.
suggested_fix: Allow header wrapping or horizontal scroll container.
